text: dsh-plugin-desktop-notify 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的桌面通知插件：当你切到其他窗口时，它会提醒你处理待授权操作、回答模型问题或查看已完成的会话回合。插件通过浏览器客户端监听审批、提问和会话状态事件，并根据窗口焦点决定是否弹出通知；通知正文会带上操作摘要或问题内容。主机端还提供诊断接口，将客户端观测记录保存为本地 JSONL 文件。适合不一直盯着 DSH 页面、但希望及时回来处理任务的用户；无需 API Key，通知依赖客户端环境提供 Notification API。

dsh-plugin-desktop-notify adds desktop alerts to DSH Web while you are away. It watches approval requests, questions, and completed turns, showing a summary when the window is not focused. No API key is needed; it uses the client Notification API and stores diagnostics in a local JSONL file.
切到别的窗口时，想知道 DSH 有没有事情需要我处理。
DSH 有审批请求或问题等我回复时，能不能弹桌面提醒？
Let me know with a desktop alert when a DSH turn finishes while I am away.
dsh-plugin-desktop-notify 的「待处理提醒」功能：收到授权请求或模型提问时，在客户端窗口不聚焦或不可见的情况下显示桌面通知，并附上操作摘要或问题内容。

dsh-plugin-desktop-notify README · dsh-plugin-desktop-notify：上下文感知的桌面通知插件，给 DSH 补上官方客户端缺失的通知能力。

已验证环境：DSH Desktop `0.2.0-rc.2`（Electron 44）· Windows 11 · `desktop` profile。
页面 origin 是 `dsh-app://app/`（安全上下文），通知权限由桌面壳自动授予，
`new Notification()` 直接出 Windows 通知中心 Toast，显示名 **DeepSeek Harness**，
声音用 Windows 自带提示音（`silent` 保持默认 false，不加自定义音效）。

dsh-plugin-desktop-notify README · 它解决什么：客户端最小化、或被别的窗口盖住时（比如你正在看浏览器 / ComfyUI），你既看不到
「需要你授权」的审批卡片，也不知道回合什么时候跑完了。本插件在这两类时刻弹一条
**系统通知**，并且正文里带上**任务摘要**，让你一眼知道要做什么。

| 情况 | 通知标题 | 正文 |
|---|---|---|
| 需要授权执行命令（`pwsh` / `bash` 等） | `有任务需要授权` | 工具名 + 该操作用途（审批理由，已剥掉 `escalate sandbox to <mode>:` 机器前缀） |
| 需要授权改文件（`write` / `edit` 等） | `有文件需要修改` | 工具名 + 该操作用途 |
| 其它工具需要确认 | `有任务需要你确认` | 工具名 + 审批理由 |
| 模型提问等你回答 | `有问题需要你回答` | 问题原文 |
| 回合结束 | `任务已完成` | 会话名 + 提示回客户端看结果 |

dsh-plugin-desktop-notify README · 什么时候**不**打扰你：- 客户端在前台（窗口获得焦点、页面可见）时：一律不弹，只在 UI 里照常显示；
- 子代理（subagent）会话的回合结束：不弹，只有主会话完成才提醒；
- 冷启动时本就处于 idle 的会话：不弹，只有观测到 `running: true -> false` 这个真实边沿才提醒；
- 同一事件 1.5 秒内重复投递：只弹一次。

用法提醒：**先在客户端发消息，再立刻切走**。回合是从你按下发送开始的，
切走之后事件才会发生在你不在场的时候；反过来（先切走再回来打字）会把你带回前台，
按设计就不弹了。

dsh-plugin-desktop-notify README · 安装：```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:<本目录>

dsh-plugin-desktop-notify README · 或从仓库装：：dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:LeeRolling/dsh-plugin-desktop-notify
```

本目录已声明 `dsh.bundle.patch` + `dsh.client`，装完**重启客户端**生效。
因为装的是 `link:`，改 `lib/client.js` 后重启即可，无需重装。

dsh-plugin-desktop-notify README · 卸载：```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-plugin-desktop-notify
```

dsh-plugin-desktop-notify README · 结构：```
package.json            dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client.platform=web
cordis.patch.yml        向 profile 插入一行 host 加载项
lib/paths.js            诊断文件位置（可覆盖，无机器相关绝对路径）
lib/index.js            宿主半：常驻诊断通道（报告接收 + 自检开关 + trace 轮转）

浏览器半订阅三个客户端事件：

| 事件 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `approval/request` | 审批瀑布，只观察不消费（`return next()` 原样放行） |
| `user-questions/request` | 模型提问瀑布，同上 |
| `api-session/status` | 会话 running 状态，取 `true -> false` 边沿 = 回合结束 |

dsh-plugin-desktop-notify README · 诊断通道（**长期保留**）：浏览器里发生的事对外部完全不可见，所以两个半之间有两条专属通道，**永久开启**，
以后任何时候通知行为不对，先看这里，不用改代码、不用加日志：

| 端点 | 方向 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `POST /api/desktop-notify/report` | 浏览器 → 宿主 | 上报每个决策：事件是否到达、被哪道闸拦下、`new Notification()` 是否抛异常、环境快照 |
| `GET /api/desktop-notify/selftest` | 浏览器 → 宿主 | 返回自检开关状态、trace 与开关的实际路径 |

dsh-plugin-desktop-notify README · 文件在哪：默认写在 `<DSH_HOME|~/.dsh>/desktop-notify/trace.jsonl`，用环境变量 `DSH_DESKTOP_NOTIFY_TRACE`
可以整体改到别处（自检开关 `selftest.flag` 始终与 trace 同目录）。目录不存在时自动创建，
**代码里没有任何写死的机器路径**。把 `DSH_DESKTOP_NOTIFY_TRACE` 设成 `off`（或
`0` / `false` / `none` / `no`）则**完全关掉**写入，端点与自检仍然可用。

trace **自轮转**：超过 512 KB 自动裁掉前半、只保留最近 256 KB（按行边界裁，JSONL 始终可解析），
长期开着也不会涨到失控。

dsh-plugin-desktop-notify README · 怎么读：| kind | 含义 |
|---|---|
| `host-apply` | 宿主半装载（pid / Electron / Node 版本 / trace 路径） |
| `client-apply` | 浏览器半装载，附环境快照（origin / 安全上下文 / 权限 / hidden / hasFocus） |
| `event` | 事件真的到达了浏览器半 |
| `suppressed` | 被闸门拦下，`reason` 是 `window-in-front` / `duplicate` / `no-permission-api` |
| `shown` | 通知真的弹了（`forced:true` 表示自检强制弹） |
| `threw` | `new Notification()` 抛异常，`message` 是原因 |
| `apply-failed` | 浏览器半**装载时**就抛了（典型原因：DSH 升级把服务或事件改名）——这条能避免"插件装着但永远不响"被误判成没装好 |

dsh-plugin-desktop-notify README · 怎么读：```sh
node tools/trace.mjs          # 统计 + 最近 15 条
node tools/trace.mjs --all    # 全量
```

dsh-plugin-desktop-notify README · 自检：在同目录放一个 `selftest.flag`（即 `<DSH_HOME|~/.dsh>/desktop-notify/selftest.flag`），
下次页面加载 2 秒后，会**无视前后台**强制弹一条标题为「通知自检」的 Toast —— 用来区分
「代码没跑」和「系统不显示」。自检完记得删掉，否则每次加载页面都会弹。

dsh-plugin-desktop-notify README · 测试：```sh
npm test
```

假 DOM + 假 Notification + 假 fetch，把浏览器半当成普通模块跑一遍：15 项断言覆盖三个事件、
分类、前台抑制、去重、子代理静默、冷启动边沿、点击（`window.focus`）与自检强制弹出。
**不需要启动 DSH**。

dsh-plugin-desktop-notify README · 验收记录：| 时间 | 场景 | 结果 |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-10-01 | 通道自检（强制弹，忽略前台） | ✅ 截图确认，trace `shown forced:true` |
| 2026-10-01 | 回合结束 + 会话摘要（真实路径） | ✅ 截图确认，trace `shown forced:false`，标题「任务已完成」，正文含会话名 |
| 2026-10-01 | 前台抑制（真实场景） | ✅ trace `suppressed window-in-front` |
| 2026-10-11 | 重启后 trace 落到新路径 | ✅ `host-apply` 记录 `~/.dsh/desktop-notify/trace.jsonl`，`traceEnabled:true` |
| 2026-10-11 | **提问类**通知（真实触发） | ✅ trace `event` 抓到完整问题正文；当时正在看客户端 → `suppressed window-in-front`（按设计不弹） |
| 2026-10-11 | **等待授权（命令类）**通知（真实审批事件） | ✅ 截图 + trace `shown forced:false`：标题「有任务需要授权」，正文 `需要授权执行命令（工具 pwsh）` + 用途摘要（`escalate sandbox to <mode>:` 前缀被正确剥掉） |
| 2026-10-11 | 从 GitHub 安装的发布版真实使用 | ✅ 多条来自发布版拷贝的 `shown`（回合结束），端到端闭环 |

dsh-plugin-desktop-notify README · 已知限制：- 「点击通知切回客户端」依赖 `window.focus()`，是尽力而为；Electron 不保证把窗口
  提到最前。preload 暴露的 `dshDesktop` 里没有 focus/flash 接口，要 100% 保证就得改
  `app.asar` 的主进程代码，会被客户端更新覆盖，暂不做。
- 只有客户端进程还活着才可能收到通知；完全退出客户端就收不到。

dsh-plugin-desktop-notify README · 致谢与来源：**用了别人的，就说出来。** 这个插件的实现是新的，但接口规范、事件契约和部分工程写法
都来自下面这些项目，逐条列清楚。

dsh-plugin-desktop-notify README · 一、直接借用：- **[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（MIT）** —— 宿主平台与插件规范本身。
  - 宿主半 `export default { inject, apply }` 的形状、`cordis.patch.yml` 的 `insert` 行格式，
    来自它的 loader / bundle 约定；
  - 浏览器半 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` + `exports.apply` /
    `exports.inject` 这套包装样板，是照它自带的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-approval`
    产物写的 —— 这是加载器的硬性接口，不是可以自由发挥的地方。
- **DSH 自带包 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-approval` / `-user-questions` / `-session`（MIT）**
  —— 本插件订阅的三个客户端事件 `approval/request`、`user-questions/request`、
  `api-session/status` 的名字与语义，都是从这几个包读出来的；本插件只是订阅者。
- **[AwesomeHou/dsh-plugin-marketplace](https://github.com/AwesomeHou/dsh-plugin-marketplace)（MIT）**
  —— `ctx.webServer.register({ kind: 'exact', path, handler })` 与 `readJsonBody()` /
  `json()` 这组 HTTP 小工具的写法，以及 `cordis.patch.yml` 里 `- insert:` 的格式，
  参考了它的实现。

text:
dsh-plugin-desktop-notify README · 三、本插件自己的部分：- 上下文分类与摘要提取（标题随情况变化：授权 / 改文件 / 提问 / 完成）；
- 常驻诊断通道（report 端点 + JSONL trace + 自动轮转 + 自检开关）；
- 假 DOM 冒烟测试。

dsh-plugin-desktop-notify README · dsh-plugin-desktop-notify：Context-aware desktop notifications for DeepSeek Harness — filling the gap left by
the official client, which has no notification feature at all.

dsh-plugin-desktop-notify README · dsh-plugin-desktop-notify：Verified on: DSH Desktop `0.2.0-rc.2` (Electron 44) · Windows 11 · `desktop` profile.
The page origin is `dsh-app://app/` (a secure context), the notification permission is
granted automatically by the desktop shell, and `new Notification()` produces a real
Windows Action Center toast titled **DeepSeek Harness**. Sound is the Windows default
(`silent` stays `false`; no custom audio).

dsh-plugin-desktop-notify README · What it solves：When the client is minimised or covered by another window (you are reading a browser,
running ComfyUI, …), you cannot see the approval card asking for your permission, and
you cannot tell when a turn finished. This plugin raises a **system notification** at
those moments, carrying the **concrete summary** of what you have to do.

dsh-plugin-desktop-notify README · What it solves：| Situation | Notification title | Body |
|---|---|---|
| Command needs approval (`pwsh` / `bash`, …) | `有任务需要授权` | tool name + what the operation is for (the approval justification, with the `escalate sandbox to <mode>:` machine prefix stripped) |
| File write needs approval (`write` / `edit`, …) | `有文件需要修改` | tool name + what the operation is for |
| Any other tool needs confirmation | `有任务需要你确认` | tool name + approval reason |
| The model is waiting for an answer | `有问题需要你回答` | the question text |
| A turn finished | `任务已完成` | session name + a nudge back to the client |

dsh-plugin-desktop-notify README · What it solves：> The notification titles are Chinese by design — the plugin was built for a
> Chinese-language workflow. See below if you want to change them.

dsh-plugin-desktop-notify README · When it stays quiet：Usage note: **send your message first, then switch away immediately.** The turn starts
when you hit send, so the events only happen while you are away. Doing it the other way
round (switch away first, then come back to type) puts the window back in front, and by
design nothing pops.

dsh-plugin-desktop-notify README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:<this directory>

dsh-plugin-desktop-notify README · or from the repository:：dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:LeeRolling/dsh-plugin-desktop-notify
```

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch` + `dsh.client`; **restart the client** to
activate. With a `link:` install, editing `lib/client.js` only needs a restart, not a
reinstall.

dsh-plugin-desktop-notify README · Uninstall：```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-plugin-desktop-notify
```

dsh-plugin-desktop-notify README · Layout：```
package.json            dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client.platform=web
cordis.patch.yml        inserts one host row into the profile
lib/paths.js            where the diagnostic files live (overridable, no machine paths)
lib/index.js            host half: the permanent diagnostic channel

The browser half subscribes to three client events:

dsh-plugin-desktop-notify README · Layout：| Event | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `approval/request` | approval waterfall — observe only, never consume (`return next()`) |
| `user-questions/request` | model question waterfall, same |
| `api-session/status` | session running state; the `true -> false` edge is a finished turn |

dsh-plugin-desktop-notify README · Diagnostic channel (**kept permanently**)：What happens in a renderer is invisible from the outside, so the two halves share two
dedicated endpoints, **always on**. Whenever a notification misbehaves, look here first —
no code changes, no extra logging:

dsh-plugin-desktop-notify README · Diagnostic channel (**kept permanently**)：| Endpoint | Direction | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `POST /api/desktop-notify/report` | browser → host | one line per decision: did the event arrive, which gate suppressed it, did `new Notification()` throw, plus an environment snapshot |
| `GET /api/desktop-notify/selftest` | browser → host | reports the self-test switch state and the resolved trace/flag paths |

dsh-plugin-desktop-notify README · Where the files are：By default the trace is written to `<DSH_HOME|~/.dsh>/desktop-notify/trace.jsonl`.
Set `DSH_DESKTOP_NOTIFY_TRACE` to relocate it (the `selftest.flag` always sits next to
the trace). The directory is created on demand — **there is no hardcoded machine path
anywhere in the code**. Setting `DSH_DESKTOP_NOTIFY_TRACE` to `off` (or `0` / `false` /
`none` / `no`) turns writing off entirely while the endpoints and self-test keep working.

dsh-plugin-desktop-notify README · Where the files are：The trace **self-rotates**: past 512 KB it drops the older half and keeps the most recent
256 KB, always cutting on a line boundary so the JSONL stays parsable.

dsh-plugin-desktop-notify README · How to read it：| kind | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `host-apply` | host half mounted (pid / Electron / Node version / trace path) |
| `client-apply` | browser half mounted, with an environment snapshot |
| `event` | the event really reached the browser half |
| `suppressed` | a gate stopped it: `window-in-front` / `duplicate` / `no-permission-api` |
| `shown` | a toast really appeared (`forced:true` = the self-test) |
| `threw` | `new Notification()` threw; `message` carries the reason |
| `apply-failed` | the browser half threw while **mounting** (typically a DSH upgrade renaming a service or event) — this is what stops "installed but never fires" from looking like "not installed" |

dsh-plugin-desktop-notify README · How to read it：```sh
node tools/trace.mjs          # counts + the last 15 entries
node tools/trace.mjs --all    # everything
```

dsh-plugin-desktop-notify README · Self-test：Drop a `selftest.flag` next to the trace (i.e.
`<DSH_HOME|~/.dsh>/desktop-notify/selftest.flag`); 2 s after the next page load a toast
titled `通知自检` is raised **regardless of focus** — that separates "the code never ran"
from "the system refused to show it". Delete the file afterwards, or it will pop on every
page load.

dsh-plugin-desktop-notify README · Tests：```sh
npm test
```

Fake DOM + fake Notification + fake fetch; the browser half is executed as an ordinary
module. 15 assertions cover the three events, classification, the front gate, dedupe,
subagent silence, the cold-idle edge, click-to-focus and the forced self-test.
**No DSH instance required.**

| 2026-10-01 | Turn end + session summary (real path) | ✅ screenshot, trace `shown forced:false` |
| 2026-10-01 | Front gate (real scenario) | ✅ trace `suppressed window-in-front` |

| 2026-10-11 | **Waiting for approval (command)** (real approval event) | ✅ screenshot + trace `shown forced:false`: title `有任务需要授权`, body `需要授权执行命令（工具 pwsh）` + the purpose summary (`escalate sandbox to <mode>:` prefix correctly stripped) |

dsh-plugin-desktop-notify README · Known limitations：- "Click the toast to come back" relies on `window.focus()`, which is best effort;
  Electron does not guarantee raising the window. The preload-exposed `dshDesktop` has no
  focus/flash call, so a hard guarantee would mean patching the `app.asar` main process —
  wiped by client updates, so it is deliberately not done.
- Notifications only arrive while the client process is alive; a fully exited client
  cannot be reached.
- The three event names are an internal DSH contract, not a published API. DSH is still
  an rc, so a rename would make the plugin go silently quiet — which is exactly what the
  trace is for.

dsh-plugin-desktop-notify README · Acknowledgments and sources：See the 「致谢与来源」 section of [README.md](README.md) — attribution is a hard requirement
for this repository.
